payload.core_composition_summary: Sorting by skill descending, then using hash map + linked list for O(1) removal of k nearest neighbors.
payload.rationale: Solution uses sorting to pre-order students by skill, then a hash map for index lookups and linked list for neighbor removal, coordinated to achieve efficient selection.
